character: A tall, narrow humanoid woman with many eyes in a ring around her head, large dark eyes, never all closed at once. Smooth brown skin, close-cropped hair.
wardrobe: A lookout's weatherproof coat, a spyglass on a cord, rope gloves.

full.framing: Full body portrait, front view. Standing on a ship's deck, one hand shading her eyes.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer.

scene.framing: In a ship's crow's nest high above the sails, pointing at a distant sail on the horizon, mouth open in a shout.
